verdict.headline: Plan A wins.
verdict.reason: Plan A reached more people and brought riders and drivers in together from the start, making more matches. Plan B started with drivers alone, leaving many waiting for rides. Plan A won 27 of 30 runs.

story.persona: You are 45 and you own a car, but you want someone else to drive you home after nights out with your friends. You can pay $14 now and then, so a short wait matters more to you than a small saving. You feel careful with a driver you have never met, so ratings and clear car details help you relax. You sometimes need a ride around town. You work as a teacher.
diary: Saw a Hopway ad in the feed. Scrolled past.
Sounds fast but I need driver ratings to feel safe.

story.persona: You are 62 and you drive yourself most days, so you only need a ride from others now and then. You move slowly with new apps, and you worry about paying before you know your ride will come. You need the price and wait to be plain, and you need to see that other riders trust this before you try it. You sometimes need a ride around town. You work as an accountant.
diary: Saw a Hopway ad in the feed. Scrolled past.
No real price or reviews, so I'm not trying it.
